project.description: The name of the library project to initialize Cypress for.

projects.description: The list of library projects to initialize Cypress for.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after initialization.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

component.description: Whether to set up Cypress component testing for the library.

generateTests.description: Whether to generate Cypress tests for the components in the library.

buildTarget.description: A build target used to configure Cypress component testing (format: `project:target[:configuration]`). Must be an Angular application.
